QUOTE: NONE
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says `memory_buffer_alloc.c` installs its calloc/free via `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()`, which exists only under `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`. It never says the buffer allocator itself requires `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, and it ends by saying it did not check whether either option is enabled.
